title: Mechanics the Gatherer — Game Mechanics Interchange Format (v1)
description: Portable JSON format for importing/exporting board-game feature references (system-level mechanics). Backward-compatible with the Gatherer's inline GAME_DATA: every existing game object validates against the 'game' definition, just wrapped in {schema, version, games:[...]}. A bare game object or bare array of games is also accepted on import (auto-wrapped).

schema.description: Fixed discriminator so the format is self-identifying.

version.description: Format version. Increment on breaking changes (major) or feature additions (minor — add 'minor' field).

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the file was exported (optional).

source.description: Where the data came from, e.g. 'BGG Geeklist 177440' (optional).

id.description: Unique slug: used as the reference-file name and lookup key.

intro.description: One-paragraph system-level summary. No lore/content detail.

url.description: Reference link (e.g. BGG game page) for provenance.

categories.description: Mechanic families. Category 'name' values should stay consistent across games where the same family appears.

name.description: Mechanic family name, e.g. 'Resource Management', 'Worker Placement', 'Deck Building'.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for dedupe/linking across games (e.g. 'deck-building' or a hash).

tags.description: Optional tags for this individual mechanic.
